name: Amberfield
subtitle: The Bell of Harvest
author: Luminati
description: Chapter Three of The Bells of Evermere: farmland under frost at golden hour — a harvest supper seven years under snow, three stopped windmills and their fog, the Harvest Mawkin in its field, the abbey of the Bell of Harvest. Generated by tools/make-bells-of-evermere.mjs.

objects.name: The Chapter House
text: The chapter house. Seven years of hymn sheets, frozen to the lectern in the middle of a verse.

objects.name: Brother Fallow's Lodge
text: A note on the door: "Gone to ring at the knights. Back for vespers. — F." It has been there seven years.

objects.name: The Reeve's House
text: The reeve's door stands open, as it has for seven years. The supper is outside, where the light was.

objects.name: The Abbey Granary
text: Seven years of grain, never threshed. It smells of a summer nobody had.

objects.name: The Cider Press
text: The press still holds its last load of apples — frozen solid, mid-squeeze.

objects.name: Old Mabry
objects.title: Reeve of Amberfield
talk: Old Mabry: Look at it. Gold to the hedges. I'd forgotten wheat could move. #line:F1B0D320FDAB17D323E48D3C0F0E78B8
Old Mabry: Sit down, sit down. The pie's seven years cold and still the best in the valley. #line:4347BE94BC45F96A7843EE7C92B1E25D
* Old Mabry: We sat down to eat, and the light never moved. The others went to Evermere when the cold set in. I stayed with the supper. #line:80BF0699C776168743F3D852221E5390
* Old Mabry: Somebody has to keep the places laid. When they come home, they'll want to know where to sit. #line:4223E58F89782A19425DC7BB9D18316B
* Old Mabry: The mills went still the same night. Hit one on the hub, if you've the arm for it. They always did need a kick to start. #line:86DE63212FF77A656B8AFBD1CE20DD21

objects.name: Cob
talk: Cob: Seven years in Evermere sleeping on my sister's floor. You've no idea what she snores like. #line:B730A2AE01E985FFF1857DD8BD57D627
- And then the abbey bell, clear across the valley, and we all just — got up and walked home. #line:F6BD78DBF013D57C10CF593116882BB7

objects.name: Saffy
talk: Saffy: That knight of yours is the best scarecrow Amberfield's ever had. Not one crow's touched the pie. #line:0A0024455200703DBC3AC72D1668DB85
- Tell it it's welcome to the field any year it likes. #line:B53BCCC22D84A636F2176772E707AEC5

objects.name: Ebba
dialogue: First pressing in seven years. It's a bit sharp. So am I.
A draught for the road? Brother Fallow blesses them. I mostly just bottle them.
